tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons / Phosphor Icons + Shadcn/UI primitives

rules.numbers_and_currency: font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace or 'Manrope', sans-serif with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
rules.h1_max: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl (Never exceed text-5xl on desktop for ERP interface)

app_shell.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar in deep navy (#0B1F3A). Expanded width 260px, collapsed width 72px. Active nav item has gold indicator border-l-4 border-[#C9A227] with soft gold tinted background (#10294D). Nav items use clean Lucide React icons.
app_shell.header: Top bar height 64px, surface background white (#FFFFFF) or navy accent with border-b border-slate-200. Features company logo/name 'KKT', search bar placeholder ('Search projects, flats, buyers...'), global notification bell, role tag, and user profile dropdown.
app_shell.main_content: Background #F5F7FB, padded with p-6 or p-8. High density and clean breathing room.

grid_modes.inventory_grid: Matrix style (Floor x Flat Position). Sticky floor row headers on left, scrollable matrix. Each blockflat tile displays flat number, BHK configuration, area in sqft, and color-coded status chip. Interactive hover lift effect.
grid_modes.dashboard_bento: 4-column responsive grid (col-span-1 for inventory metric cards, col-span-2 row-span-2 for project pipeline chart, col-span-2 for block progress bars, col-span-1 for recent audit activity feed).

login_page.left_panel: Deep Navy (#0B1F3A) background with subtle metallic geometric grain texture, massive high-end KKT Real Estate ERP branding, royalty luxury tag line, key metric counter badges, and highrise background photo overlay at opacity 0.25.
login_page.right_panel: Clean white background with centered form, high-contrast inputs, gold active focus ring, password toggle, tenant/employee login options, and quick demo credentials populator.

inventory_grid_drawer.behavior: Clicking any flat in the Block Inventory Grid slides in a right-side Sheet/Drawer.
inventory_grid_drawer.drawer_content: Flat details (Flat No, BHK, Super Area, Carpet Area, Facing, Floor, Base Price in Indian Lakhs/Crores, Total Cost breakdown, Buyer Details if Booked/Sold, Status change dropdown, Payment schedule preview, Action CTA buttons: 'Hold Flat', 'Book Flat', 'Generate Cost Sheet').

master_data_section.structure: Dense table view with expandable side sheet / slide-over modal for creating or editing Master Data entities (Flat Types, Wings, Payment Plans, Amenities, Extra Charges).
master_data_section.flat_type_form: Dynamic multi-row input builder for room dimensions, carpet area calculation, and surcharge matrices.

users_and_roles.role_editor: Grouped permission matrix table with accordions (Projects, Inventory, Financials, Reports, Admin). Checkboxes for Read, Create, Edit, Delete, Export, Approve per module.

tables.style: Dense sticky header tables, subtle hover rows (bg-slate-50), compact padding (py-3 px-4), column search inputs in table headers, sorting indicators, skeleton row loaders during fetching, pagination footer with page size selection.

formatting_rules.indian_currency: Format all monetary values using Indian numbering system (e.g. ₹1.2 Cr, ₹45.5 L, ₹8,50,000). Use dedicated formatting utility helper `formatIndianCurrency(val)`.

image_urls.description: Luxury high-rise modern architecture photo for Login left banner overlay.
Modern residential luxury high-rise tower photo for Project Detail header banner.
Architectural residential building preview photo for Block overview card.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive elements, navigation links, buttons, form inputs, status chips, table headers, drawer controls, modals, and metric cards MUST have explicit `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='sidebar-projects-link', data-testid='flat-chip-101', data-testid='hold-flat-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rule: Header dropdowns and overlays MUST NOT use transparent backgrounds. Always use solid white bg-white or bg-[#10294D] dark popovers with shadow-lg and border border-slate-200.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_state_rule: Always explicitly define hover text colors alongside background changes (e.g. hover:bg-[#0B1F3A] hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React JavaScript (.js and .jsx files). Do not use TypeScript .tsx syntax.
Implement the theme tokens in tailwind.config.js and src/index.css so that bg-navy-900, bg-navy-800, text-gold-500, etc. work seamlessly across components.
Create reusable UI components in src/components/ui/ including Button, Input, Select, Table, Badge, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, DropdownMenu, Skeleton, and Toaster (Sonner).

Include mock state and complete CRUD workflows for Phase 1: Authentication, Projects -> Blocks -> Flat grid generation, Flat drawer details, Master Data dynamic forms, Role permissions checkbox matrix, and Audit Log filterable list.
Ensure Indian currency formatting function is used everywhere numbers represent prices (Lakhs 'L' and Crores 'Cr').
Ensure every clickable button, input, tab, table row, flat grid cell, and modal trigger includes a data-testid attribute.
